name: @ai-ecoverse/slicc-browsers
description: SLICC's shared browser catalog, JSON schemas and discovery conformance corpus

scripts.lint: slicc-lint && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go mod tidy -diff && go vet ./... && golangci-lint run && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run validate && node --test test/integration/self-contained.test.mjs test/integration/browser-runner.test.mjs test/integration/fixture-client.test.mjs test/integration/git-retry.test.mjs && go test -race -count=1 ./test/integration/... && cargo test --all-features
scripts.build: go build ./... && cargo build --all-features && cargo build --target wasm32-wasip1 --all-features && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.test:guard: npm run test:guard-integration && npm run test:guard-sweep
scripts.test:guard-integration: node --test --test-concurrency=2 test/integration/guard-lifecycle.test.mjs test/integration/guard-fit.test.mjs test/integration/guard-chain.test.mjs test/integration/guard-validation.test.mjs test/integration/guard-liveness.test.mjs test/integration/guard-observations.test.mjs test/integration/guard-child-latency.test.mjs test/integration/guard-adoption.test.mjs test/integration/guard-scoping.test.mjs test/integration/guard-late-pause.test.mjs test/integration/guard-legs.test.mjs test/integration/guard-fetch-enable.test.mjs test/integration/guard-diagnostics.test.mjs test/integration/guard-chrome.test.mjs test/integration/guard-worlds.test.mjs test/integration/guard-world-discovery.test.mjs test/integration/guard-world-guesses.test.mjs test/integration/guard-unparseable.test.mjs test/integration/guard-redirect-secret.test.mjs test/integration/guard-error-page.test.mjs test/integration/guard-discovery.test.mjs test/integration/guard-browser-page.test.mjs test/integration/guard-scales.test.mjs test/integration/guard-shared-log.test.mjs test/integration/guard-pre-beacon.test.mjs test/integration/guard-world-pause.test.mjs test/integration/self-contained.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit:redirect: mkdir -p coverage/unit && node --experimental-test-coverage --test --test-coverage-include=redirect-secret.mjs --test-coverage-include=redirect-fragments.mjs --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/unit/redirect.lcov test/unit/guard-redirect-*.test.mjs && slicc-diff-cover coverage/unit/redirect.lcov
scripts.test:unit:guard: mkdir -p coverage/unit && node --experimental-vm-modules --no-warnings --experimental-test-coverage --test --test-coverage-include=guard-runner.mjs --test-coverage-include=fixture-server.mjs --test-coverage-include=fixture-client.mjs --test-coverage-include=observer-target.mjs --test-coverage-include=protected-error-page.mjs --test-coverage-include=unparseable-url.mjs --test-coverage-include=scripts/browser-runner.mjs --test-coverage-include=scripts/validate.mjs --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/unit/guard.lcov test/unit/guard-*.test.mjs && slicc-diff-cover coverage/unit/guard.lcov
